Cr.derivation: Initial estimate for fr ~ 250kHz with Lr ~ 25µH. Exact value to be determined by simulation.
Cr.notes: Placeholder value. Simulation will optimize for resonant frequency and regulation range.

Lr.derivation: Initial estimate for fr ~ 250kHz with Cr ~ 100nF. Typically integrated as transformer leakage inductance.
Lr.notes: Placeholder value. This inductance is designed into the transformer, not a discrete component. Simulation will determine exact requirement.

Rsense.derivation: Signal level vs. power loss trade-off. At 8A RMS: V = I×R = 8A × 10mΩ = 80mV (adequate for differential amplifier). P = I²R = 64 × 0.01 = 0.64W (acceptable loss).
Rsense.margin: 80mV signal provides good SNR. 0.64W < 1W power budget. Can increase to 20mΩ if more signal needed.
Rsense.notes: Conservative starting point. Simulation may adjust based on actual current waveform and amplifier requirements.

fr_resonant.margin: Frequency will be adjusted via component values to achieve target. Operating range typically 100-500kHz for regulation.
fr_resonant.notes: Initial calculation shows ~318kHz. Simulation will optimize Lr and Cr for target fr = 250kHz.

Q_quality_factor.derivation: Target Q = 0.3-0.5 for good regulation range (per TI SLUP263). Q = √(Lr/Cr) / Rac
Q_quality_factor.margin: Q in range 0.3-0.5 provides good regulation without excessive frequency variation
Q_quality_factor.notes: Rac depends on load and transformer ratio. Simulation will calculate actual Q at operating point.
